card.name: Targets and projections about the future
card.fires_on: Positions just before a future target or projected figure, such as the digits of a year like 2050 or a percentage goal after 'projects that' or 'target of'. Also fires on scattered other spots in general web prose.

modes.label: Future targets
modes.description: The space or digit just before a projected year or percent goal in energy-policy text.

card.writes: It suppresses 'future' and 'futures' words, so it pushes against writing the word future next.
card.plain: It notices text about future goals and projections, and holds back the word 'future' itself.
